representations.name: morgan
representations.blurb: Morgan (ECFP4) 2048-bit fingerprints - the baseline every model must beat.

representations.name: fcfp4
representations.blurb: Feature-Morgan (FCFP4) 2048 bits: same radius as ECFP4 but pharmacophoric atom types.

representations.name: morgan_count
representations.blurb: Count-based ECFP4 (2048 hashed counts, cosine) - substructure multiplicity, not just presence.

representations.name: maccs
representations.blurb: MACCS keys: 167 hand-written SMARTS substructure questions (bit 0 unused).

representations.name: rdkit_fp
representations.blurb: RDKit path fingerprint, 2048 bits: hashed linear subgraphs up to 7 bonds.

representations.name: atom_pair
representations.blurb: Atom-pair fingerprint, 2048 bits: (atom type, atom type, topological distance) triples.

representations.name: topological_torsion
representations.blurb: Topological-torsion fingerprint, 2048 bits: hashed 4-atom paths - local backbone shape.

representations.name: avalon
representations.blurb: Avalon fingerprint, 1024 bits: a curated enumeration of paths, rings and atom environments.

representations.name: pattern_fp
representations.blurb: RDKit pattern fingerprint, 2048 bits: substructure-screening bits, deliberately coarse.

representations.name: layered_fp
representations.blurb: RDKit layered fingerprint, 2048 bits: path bits hashed over several atom/bond abstraction layers.

representations.name: gobbi_pharm2d
representations.blurb: Gobbi 2D pharmacophore fingerprint, feature triangles by topological distance bin; >150 heavy atoms skipped.

representations.name: usrcat
representations.blurb: USRCAT on one ETKDGv3/MMFF conformer: 60 shape+pharmacophore moments, z-scored, cosine.

representations.name: rdkit_descriptors
representations.blurb: Physicochemical descriptors, z-scored. Tests whether bulk properties suffice.

representations.name: mw_logp
representations.blurb: Molecular weight + cLogP only, z-scored - a deliberately weak 2-feature control.

representations.name: murcko_scaffold
representations.blurb: One-hot Bemis-Murcko scaffold identity: similarity 1 iff same scaffold, else 0.

representations.name: chemberta
representations.blurb: ChemBERTa-77M-MLM, mean-pooled last hidden state over non-pad tokens (not the CLS token).

representations.name: random
representations.blurb: Random vectors - the floor. Any representation must beat this.

not_evaluated.gobbi_pharm2d over 150 heavy atoms: 23 of 2114 drugs exceed the cap and get a zero row (counted in n_failed). Measured: <10 ms at the median 24 heavy atoms, 31-60+ s each at 279-342 atoms
not_evaluated.multi-conformer usrcat: one ETKDGv3 conformer per molecule only; a conformer ensemble is the correct way to use USRCAT but costs ~20x the CPU and was not run
not_evaluated.GPU-backed molecular encoders: no GPU and no hosted-inference credential on this machine (docs/03-SCOPE-AND-CONSTRAINTS.md); chemberta runs on CPU, anything larger does not
